item.title: The Oaklandside wins prestigious award for advancing press freedom and government transparency
item.description: The Oaklandside wins prestigious award for advancing press freedom and government transparency The newsroom earned the James Madison Freedom of Information award for exposing systematic violations of open records laws by city officials and challenging Alameda County’s sideshow spectator ban.

item.title: Sogorea Te’ Land Trust and city of Oakland protect Sausal Creek headwaters
item.description: Sogorea Te’ Land Trust and city of Oakland protect Sausal Creek headwaters The City Council agreed to give the indigenous-led organization over $800,000 in Measure DD funds to conserve 16-acres in the Oakland hills.

item.title: The East Bay’s tastiest, most tantalizing SF Beer Week events
item.description: The East Bay’s tastiest, most tantalizing SF Beer Week events From multiple beer and cheese pairings, to speed dating, taste offs and wrestling, the 2026 Beer Week lineup has something for everyone.

item.title: Who stole Barbara Lee’s car?
item.description: Who stole Barbara Lee’s car? A city-owned vehicle used by the mayor of Oakland was stolen over the holiday weekend after a break-in at her City Hall office.

item.title: Caught curling fever from the Olympics? Here’s where you can try it in Oakland
item.description: Caught curling fever from the Olympics? Here’s where you can try it in Oakland The San Francisco Bay Area Curling Club is the only dedicated curling facility in California. It’s hosting “learn to curl” workshops and beginner lessons all through the spring.

item.title: Lunar New Year events to check out in Oakland
item.description: Lunar New Year events to check out in Oakland A lion dance in the Laurel, cherry blossom crafts in Jack London Square, a night market in Chinatown and many more ways to bring in the new year in Oakland.

item.title: Expansion of Oakland’s East Bay Greenway to break ground later this year
item.description: Expansion of Oakland’s East Bay Greenway to break ground later this year Three more miles of protected cycle tracks will make biking from Fruitvale to Lake Merritt and Downtown safer.

item.title: Cal’s and Mt. Agni go dark, plus the last East Bay outpost of a classic Italian deli has closed
item.description: Cal’s and Mt. Agni go dark, plus the last East Bay outpost of a classic Italian deli has closed A running list of restaurants that have recently closed in Berkeley, Oakland, Richmond, and beyond.

item.title: Oscar Grant would have turned 40 this month. A new exhibit celebrates his life
item.description: Oscar Grant would have turned 40 this month. A new exhibit celebrates his life “Happy Heavenly Birthday Oscar,” an installation about the young Oakland man killed by a BART police officer in 2009, is up through Feb. 28 at the Black Panther Party Museum.

item.title: Oakland’s Alysa Liu wins gold medal in Olympic figure skating
item.description: Oakland’s Alysa Liu wins gold medal in Olympic figure skating After taking a two-and-a-half-year hiatus from the sport, the 20 year-old has now won two gold medals at the Winter Olympics in Italy.
